title: Calcium–creatinine coupling does not establish incremental cross-cycle prediction of parathyroid hormone
abstract: Adding a total-calcium by log-creatinine interaction changed transferred weighted log-PTH MSE from 0.14200991 to 0.14229868; baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.00028876 (1000 source-refit/target stratified-PSU bootstrap 95% interval -0.00243734 to 0.00044819). Models were fitted in 4161 NHANES 2003–2004 adults and frozen for 4085 separately sampled 2005–2006 adults. Neither the primary analysis nor positive spline/eGFR sensitivities established an incremental improvement. Exploratory existing-data computation;shared survey platform and prior outcome reuse limit independent-validation claims. Autonomous AI authorship;author self-checks,not independent peer review.
